label: preparing
what: Likely a surprise community celebration for my forty years as mayor, presented to me as tomorrow's 18:00 great hall lighting and readiness check. Builder and innkeeper are arranging the hall and escort; baker may be supplying bread (seen carrying a sack at the inn). Secretary knowingly helps schedule the visit, though I have no proof the secretary knows a concealed celebratory purpose. The celebration itself is an inference, not something I have been told.
